name: vacuum-compiler
description: Roadmap #11: the vacuum compiler, executed — circuits compiled into the ground state of a Feynman-Kitaev Hamiltonian, with the machine-certificate layer and the energy ledger the claim never came with. Known in theory (FEY85 clocks, KSV02 Ch. 14, KKR06 QMA-completeness; LLO96 simulation) — never machine-verified as a compiler with a readout cost audit. Delivered here: the compiler certificate (H|psi_hist> = 0 to machine precision for random circuits, ground-state degeneracy accounting, input/output penalty checks); exact conditional readout (measuring the clock at step t hands you U_t...U_1|psi_in> with fidelity exactly 1); the spectral gap law with the path-Laplacian closed form 1-cos(pi/(T+1)) as anchor; and the honest ledger — static storage costs zero work but every readout path pays (uniform clock marginal => (T+1)·log2(T+1) expected erasure bits; a fuel tilt buys success probability and dirties the conditional state at O((eps/gap)^2); the free clock walk never garbles the program but rarely delivers it). The wall, stated plainly: the vacuum stores and attests computation, it never beats running it. v0.2.0: the DTC eternal-clock boundary GRADUATED at the model layer (dtc-clock v0.19.0 TC14/TC17 legislated and won the tariff 0 < 5 < 9 < 43.02 with the FK entry quoted from this repo's T4; route-price v0.2.0 W-E receipted it) — this repo re-derives the ordering as the independent third path in exact integer arithmetic ((T+1)^(T+1) vs 2^c, the 43.02 rounding certified tight, sibling citations re-audited read-only at every repro); the amplification face (per-round soundness eps of a unique-input program pinned by the trajectory law; k rounds decay it exactly eps^k / (1-eps)^k — exact rationals, binomial identity at BigInt residue 0, seeded MC inside 5 sigma, resolution floor honest, completeness 1^k = 1, priced k·(T+1)·log2(T+1) bits); and the walk's coherent price one step deeper (second walk family, depth sweep: sigma_E exactly 1/2, conserved, Mandelstam–Tamm floor pi/(2·sigma_E) = pi)
